# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release receives security patches. Consumers pin an exact version
in their `Package.swift` — update your pin to the latest release to receive fixes.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.6.0   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.6.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in symaira-appkit, please report it
privately via GitHub's [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-appkit/security/advisories/new).

We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide an initial assessment
within 5 business days. Please do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

For general security questions, contact security@symaira.com.
